name: Digital Conformity Credential (UNTP)
description: UN Transparency Protocol 0.7.0 Digital Conformity Credential: a conformity assessment body's attestation about a party's product, facility or organisation.
summary: Credential type template for the UNTP 0.7.0 DigitalConformityCredential, a W3C VCDM 2.0 credential (jwt_vc_vcdm) with the UNTP context and schema. It is issued by a conformity assessment body to the supplier or manufacturer that holds it, who may publish it as a "dcc" link or keep it private, as in workflows/dpp-workflow.md. The form covers the ConformityAttestation: assessor and assessment level, attestation type, the party it is issued to and the conformity scheme. The individual conformity assessments are nested deeper than the form describes. Issued by the noop/dpp_assessment_body wallet template.
